ceu: ✦ The trine between the Moon and Mars at {H:1828466616000}

s.k: A day to sort out what really matters to you.
t: The Moon passes through your area of money and security. It is a good day to look at your accounts calmly and without fear.

The trine between the Moon and Mars brings together, in your favour, money and your career: the Moon brings emotion and intuition, Mars brings courage and initiative. Let things flow without forcing them.
s.d: Put aside a small amount, just to build the habit.

s.k: Your presence speaks for itself today.
t: With the Moon in your sign, your intuition is sharper than usual. Trust what you feel at first impression.

The trine between the Moon and Mars brings together, in your favour, your image and your horizons: the Moon brings emotion and intuition, Mars brings courage and initiative. Put your heart and your head on the same side.
s.d: Look after your image: a haircut, a new piece of clothing or simply standing up straight.

t: With the Moon in your house of silence, dreams and intuition bring answers. Watch for the signs.

The trine between the Moon and Mars brings together, in your favour, your inner life and intimacy: the Moon brings emotion and intuition, Mars brings courage and initiative. It is a day for sowing: what you do today grows over time.
s.d: Forgive yourself for something that is already in the past.

s.k: The right friends make all the difference.
t: The Moon favours sharing and helping one another. What you give to others comes back to you in other ways.

The trine between the Moon and Mars brings together, in your favour, friendships and relationships: the Moon brings emotion and intuition, Mars brings courage and initiative. Use it to take a step you keep putting off.
s.d: Picture your ideal future for five minutes, in detail.

s.k: A day to show what you are worth.
t: Others notice your effort. Do your best, even in the tasks nobody applauds.

The trine between the Moon and Mars brings together, in your favour, your career and routine: the Moon brings emotion and intuition, Mars brings courage and initiative. Accept whatever help comes along, wherever it comes from.
s.d: Finish one important task before starting another.

s.k: Faith in the path opens the path.
t: The Moon passes through your area of horizons. You feel like learning, travelling or simply seeing things differently.

The trine between the Moon and Mars brings together, in your favour, your horizons and romance: the Moon brings emotion and intuition, Mars brings courage and initiative. It is a good moment to bring the two together in a single plan.
s.d: Say a prayer or set an intention for your path.

s.k: What runs deep asks for truth.
t: Today is a day to let go of what weighs you down: a resentment, a habit, an old distrust.

The trine between the Moon and Mars brings together, in your favour, intimacy and family: the Moon brings emotion and intuition, Mars brings courage and initiative. Use this good energy to sort out what had stalled.
s.d: Take a deep breath whenever you feel jealousy or distrust.

s.k: Together you go further than alone.
t: With the Moon in your house of partnerships, the balance between giving and receiving is at stake. Look for the middle ground.

The trine between the Moon and Mars brings together, in your favour, relationships and conversations: the Moon brings emotion and intuition, Mars brings courage and initiative. Doors open more easily when you ask clearly.
s.d: Ask the person beside you how you can help.

s.k: Your body is asking for attention: listen to it.
t: The Moon asks for method and care with the details. A small adjustment to your routine makes a difference.

The trine between the Moon and Mars brings together, in your favour, routine and money: the Moon brings emotion and intuition, Mars brings courage and initiative. An idea from today could become a real project.
s.d: Get up from your chair every hour and stretch.

s.k: Let joy in without asking permission.
t: A day to shine without fear. What you do with passion is contagious to those around you.

The trine between the Moon and Mars brings together, in your favour, romance and your image: the Moon brings emotion and intuition, Mars brings courage and initiative. Trust what you are building: today the sky lends a hand.
s.d: Show someone what you have created, without fear of criticism.

t: The Moon passes through your area of home and family. It is a day to be close to those who give you roots.

The trine between the Moon and Mars brings together, in your favour, family and your inner life: the Moon brings emotion and intuition, Mars brings courage and initiative. Smile more: kindness opens paths today.
s.d: Offer help to someone in your family without waiting to be asked.

s.k: Curiosity switched on: ask, listen, learn.
t: Today your mind is quicker and more curious. Use it to settle pending matters in writing or in person.

The trine between the Moon and Mars brings together, in your favour, conversations and friendships: the Moon brings emotion and intuition, Mars brings courage and initiative. A small gesture can have a big effect today.
s.d: Call a brother, sister, cousin or neighbour just to see how they are.
